objective: Clothing Store Management System — Master Prompt 3 of 4: Accounting, Financial Reports, HR, Dashboards, Notifications & Data Management
acceptance_criteria: Chart of Accounts and Financial Accounts (Cash, bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Bank, Card Settlement, Supplier Accounts) with atomic transfers, fees, and reconciliation
Categorized Expense Management with configurable Super Admin approval thresholds and cash control integration
Employee Management, Manual Attendance, and Salary Management (Advances, Partial Payments, Outstanding Balances, Duplicate Prevention)
Financial Reporting & Inventory Costing: Net Sales Revenue, COGS (WAC), Gross Profit, Operating Profit, Tax/VAT reporting
Store-Level Cash Reconciliation integrated with daily closing/opening controls and discrepancy audit
Role-specific Dashboards for Super Admin, Store Manager, Cashier, Warehouse Staff, and Accountant
Comprehensive Reporting & Filtering (Sales, Profit, Expenses, Cash, Payments, Suppliers, Stock Valuation, Slow-Moving Stock, Attendance, Salaries)
Scheduled Reports and Multi-format Exports (PDF, Excel/CSV) with formula injection protection and secure temporary files
Controlled Data Import/Export Engine with validation preview, duplicate detection, chunking, and idempotency
Notifications and Alerts (Low stock, Supplier dues, Transfer delays, Large expense approvals, Cash closing reminders) with observable delivery logging
Scheduled Tasks via Laravel Scheduler (Low-stock checks, due reminders, transfer delays, daily summaries, cleanup)
Automated test suite passing 100% with zero regression on Phase 1 and 2 tests
non_goals: Do not implement shift-management or complex biometrics (manual store attendance only)
Do not implement offline sales or sync queues
Do not hardcode arbitrary expense thresholds; make them configurable
